Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! India Women fielders make their way out in the middle. Followed by Tammy Beaumont and Danni Wyatt. Shikha Pandey to start with the ball.

Right then! England Women need 154 to chase and win the series. On the other hand, India Women will need early wickets if they want to pull off a win. The game is nicely poised. Do join us in a bit for the run chase.

England got off to a brilliant start as Katherine Brunt got rid of the big fish in the name of Shafali Verma very for a duck. Natalie Sciver then came into the attack and removed Harleen Deol in her first over itself. The bowlers didn't allow the runs to come freely until the first 10 overs and kept India Women on the back foot. Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana did trouble them for a while but Natalie Sciver had other plans. She removed the Indian Women skipper and again the runs dried up a little bit. Sophie Ecclestone was the pick of the bowlers as she scalped 3 wickets though went for too many runs. The bowlers managed to pick up wickets from time to time but were a bit rusty and were punished for that.

A decent batting performance! Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma opened the innings for the India Women. While Shafali Verma departed for a duck, Mandhana continued to keep the scoreboard ticking. Harleen Deol too departed for a timid score. After that, the skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur and Mandhana joined hands to stitch a partnership. Both the batsmen started to attack and built an important 68-run partnership before Kaur got out.  Sneh Rana too couldn't hand around much. Richa Ghosh played a good cameo and supported Mandhana well. Her cameo towards the end helped India Women to post a total of 153.
Short on middle, Deepti pulls it to deep mid-wicket but there is protection there so just a run to finish the innings. INDIA WOMEN FINISH WITH 153/6!
Good fielding! Shorter on middle, Deepti pulls it to the right of deep mid-wicket. The fielder there dives and saves a couple of runs for her side. Brings up the 150 for India Women.
Tossed up on middle, Arundhati Reddy whips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Arundhati Reddy is the new batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED! Sophie Ecclestone has the last laugh and a joy of relief. Short on middle and leg. Richa moves away from the stumps and looks to punch. Unfortunately she misses but Sophie Ecclestone does not and the ball hits the top of middle and leg.
EDGED AND FOUR! Ecclestone follows Gosh outside leg. Ghosh looks to hit it over extra cover but gets a thick outside edge which sees the ball go through the third man region for a boundary.
FOUR! Just the start India Women needed for the final over. Short on the pads, Richa Ghosh slogs it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Deepti punches it through covers for a couple.
A dipping low full toss. Deepti cannot do much but just push it to mid on.

Run out chance but missed! Full on middle, Deepti plays it to the right of long on. They call for two and go for it. The throw at the keeper's end is a little wide and the keeper too fails to gather it cleanly.  Allowing Deepti's dive to get back in
Length ball outside off. Deepti looks to cut but misses.
Targets the pads. Ghosh turns it to mid-wicket and looks for two but has to be content with one.
Full on the middle and leg. Deepti nudges it through mid on for one.
Natalie Sciver to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
A low full toss outside off, Ghosh went for the drive but failed to connect.
Slower delivery wide outside off, Ghosh throws her bat and gets a top edge. The ball flies towards deep cover where the fielder puts in a dive but it drops short. Two taken.
Slower and short on off, Sharma punches it towards covers for one.
Fuller on middle, worked behind the bowler for one.
Full and on off, pushed towards point.

NOT OUT! Length delivery on middle, Sharma hangs back into the crease and looks to work it on the leg side. She fails to connect it and gets hit on the pads. The batsman take a run off the leg bye. Meanwhile, England Women appeal for an LBW but nothing from the umpire. They take the review. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows impact was umpire's call.
Review time! LBW appeal against Deepti Sharma has been turned down but Heather Knight has decided to review it. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Change in bowling. Freya Davies is back on.
Shout for an LBW but not given! Length ball on middle and leg, Ghosh looks to work it on the leg side but misses. She is rapped on the pads. Brunt appeals for LBW but the umpire is not interested.
Slower on middle and leg, Ghosh works it off the outer half of her blade towards square leg.
FOUR! Make that two in two! Bangs in short on off, Richa Ghosh flat-bats it towards mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! Full on off, Richa Ghosh drills it through mid on for a boundary.
Who will walk out to bat? Deepti Sharma is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Low full toss on middle, dipping in, Smriti Mandhana looks to go big. She lofts it towards deep mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver is present over there and gulps down the catch. She won't drop those. End of a terrific innings. Katherine Brunt is delighted and roars. Mandhana puts her head down and walks back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Katherine Brunt

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Shouts for 'CATCH, CATCH' but it's nowhere near the fielder. Touch fuller on leg, Smriti Mandhana heaves it towards long off for a boundary.
Change in bowling. Katherine Brunt is back on.
Flatter delivery on middle, pushed to mid on for one.
Quicker again on the pads, Ghosh looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The batters take a run of leg bye.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat now.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Flatter and quicker delivery on middle, Rana looks to slog sweep it. She gets on her knees to attempt the slog sweep but misses it out completely. The ball skids on to shatter the middle stump. Sneh Rana has to depart for a timid score. Sophie Ecclestone gets her second wicket of the game.
Tossed up on off, Mandhana dabs it to point for a quick single.
SIX! HIGH AND HANDSOME! Loopy ball on middle, Smriti Mandhana gets in a wonderful position. She gets down on her knee and slog sweeps it to send the ball over deep square leg for a biggie.
Darted on the pads, Rana tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Much better from Freya Davies. The last ball is on the stumps. Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
Sophie Ecclestone is back into the attack.
WIDE! Too far outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline. Wided by the umpire.
Full on middle and leg, Mandhana glances it through square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Another poor ball! Full toss on the pads, Mandhana hits it through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Mandhana looks to play but misses.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR Smriti Mandhana! This has been a very good knock from her but she needs to carry on. Short on the pads, Mandhana swivels it through square leg for a boundary to bring up her milestone.
WIDE! Freya Davies has to reload! She misses her line and bowls one down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
Just short! Good length ball on middle, Mandhana lofts it away to long on. The fielder there charges forward and puts in a dive to catch the ball. But drops just short of her. Two runs taken.
Freya Davies (2-0-14-0) is back into the attack.

Appeal for LBW but missing leg says the umpire. Tossed up delivery pitching on middle and skids on. Sneh looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the back pad. A huge appeal follows but the umpire is unmoved.
Mady flights one on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Poor ball and gets punished! Short on the pads, Mandhana clips it fine down the leg side and gets a boundary.
Short and wide outside off. Mandhana taps it to point.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and gets the desired result. Tossed up on off, Smriti comes down the track and hits it over extra cover for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Sneh flicks it and gets to the other end.
Mady Villiers comes back into the attack. Conceded 10 runs in her first overs.
Length ball around off, Sneh runs it down to third man and keeps the strike.
Length ball around off, Mandhana punches it to cover for a run.
Sneh Rana walks out to bat.
Sneh is off the mark! Fuller on the pads, Rana turns it to the on side for a single.
On middle. Rana keeps it out.
Full on the stumps. Sneh pushes it to cover.
India Women opt for a review against an LBW decision. Ultra Edge shows a flat line. The Ball Tracker shows all three reds. The on-field decision stays. India Women lose their review now.
Natalie Sciver is back into the attack. Her figures read 2-0-7-0.

OUT! LBW! The Indian skipper has to walk back. She was looking so good out in the middle but Natalie Sciver has brought an end to her innings. The review does not save Harmanpreet Kaur and she takes the review with her. Full ball around off and nipping back in. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to defend but misses and gets hit right in front pad. There is a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Harmanpreet Kaur decides to take a chance and goes for the review.  Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows no spike. Time for the Ball Tracker and it shows all reds.
Another good over for India! The last ball is floated on off, Kaur pushes it through covers and keeps the strike.
FOUR! Short and punished! Short and wide outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it through covers for a boundary.

Review time! England Women have taken a review for a caught behind. Harmanpreet Kaur is the batsman in question. Ultra Edge confirms there is no contact between bat and ball. The on-field decision stays. England Women lose their review.

NOT OUT! Harmanpreet Kaur survives! England lose their review! Short and down the leg side, Kaur looks to pull but misses. There is a huge appeal from the England Women players but the umpire is unmoved. They opt to go for the review. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge finds a spike but that is not when the ball goes past the bat but when it passes the thigh pad.
FOUR! This time the Indian skipper uses her feet! Floated on middle, Harmanpreet comes down the track and hits it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! Flighted outside off, Harmanpreet sits down on her knees and drags her sweep to the right of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Darted fuller on middle. Harmanpreet pushes it to mid on.
WIDE! Short but down the leg side. Kaur looks pull but misses.
A single to end the over! Slower ball on off, Kaur helps it off the inner half of her blade towards fine leg.
Short around off, Mandhana pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Mandhana drives it to point.

Back of a length on off, Mandhana lifts it over mid-wicket. She collects a couple of runs. Oh wait... The umpire sees the replay and calls one run short as Mandhana did not drag her bat inside the crease while taking the first run.
Good comeback! Pitches it on a length on off, Mandhana taps it towards mid off.
SIX! Davies goes full and gets punished! Fuller length on off, Smriti Mandhana heaves it over long off for a maximum. Effortless hitting! Moes onto 34 with that shot.
On the pads, Mandhana turns it to the on side and keeps the strike.
Appeal for LBW but turned down! Floated outside off, Kaur looks to sweep but misses. The ball goes fine down the leg side off the inner half of the bat for a single.
Flighted on middle, Mandhana pushes it to long off for a run.
This time Villiers darts it quicker as Harmanpreet comes down the track. The Indian skipper turns it to the on side for one.
SIX! Shot of the game so far! Floated on off, Harmanpreet decides to dance down the track and smash it over long on for a biggie.
Floated on off, Harmanpreet defends it.
More spin for England Women. Mady Villiers is introduced into the attack now.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Kaur plays an on-drive to end the over. A run is taken.
Fired on the pads, Mandhana flicks it towards square leg for another single.
Flatter and quicker on middle, clipped to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up delivery on off, Mandhana lofts it down the wicket for a single.
Full and on middle, Mandhana tucks it on the leg side.
FOUR! Pure connection! Ecclestone errs in her line! Slips it down the leg side, Smriti Mandhana takes advantage of it. She sweeps it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Floated it up on off, Mandhana shimmies down the track and drives it towards long off. She crosses ends.
Loopy ball on off, Kaur prods and drives it to long off for a single.
Low full toss on leg, Kaur sweeps it to short fine leg.
Full toss on middle, Kaur advances down the track and plays it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Fabulous placement! Tossed up outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur rocks back and punches it through point for a boundary.
Fractionally short on middle, Mandhana drags it to mid-wicket for one.
Change in bowling. Sarah Glenn is introduced into the attack.
Full on middle and leg, Kaur works it to mid on. Still a good over from England Women's perspective.
FOUR! STREAKY! Length ball on off, Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on his knees, watches the ball closely. In the end, paddle scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Slower delivery on middle, Kaur blocks it out.
Length ball outside off, Mandhana cuts it towards point for one.
Touch fuller on off, Mandhana prods and drives it to mid off. India Women off to a slow start.
Starts with a length ball on off, Mandhana opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards covers.
Change in bowling.
Sweetly timed but there is protection in the deep. Length ball on middle, Mandhana pulls it towards square leg for a single. End of the Powerplay. India Women are 28/2.
Short of a length on off, Kaur guides it to third man for a single.
Sprays this one down the leg side, Mandhana glances it to short fine leg for one.
Length ball outside off, Mandhana steers it straight to point.
Touch fuller on middle, Kaur tucks it towards square leg for an easy single.
On off, Kaur defends it towards point.
Fullish ball on off, Mandhana keeps it out.
FOUR! Good thinking! Mandhana did not time it well but gets it over the in-field. Mandhana comes down the track and chips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Again Brunt bowls it on top of off stump. Mandhana cannot clear her arms and has to block it.
Much better from Katherine Brunt! Corrects her line and bowls it on off. Mandhana taps it to point.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shortish on the pads, Mandhana just places it through backward square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Katherine Brunt misses her line and sprays one down the leg side. She has to reload that again.
Fuller on off, Mandhana pushes it to cover.
Tossed up on off, Harmanpreet blocks it.
Floated on the pads, Mandhana turns it to the on side for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur is off the mark! Harmanpreet gets one on the pads, flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
The skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Harleen departs and Ecclestone has the last laugh! Excellent catch from Sciver. Ecclestone goes fuller and bowls it a little quicker. Harleen Deol looks to sweep it over mid-wicket. She mistimes it and it falls on its way to short mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver there dives and takes a superb catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Excellent footwork and brilliant head position. Tossed up on middle, Harleen comes down the track and hits it crisply through mid on for a boundary.
Ecclestone starts with a shortish ball that turns a little away. Deol taps it to point.
Sophie Ecclestone comes into the attack.
Length again on middle and leg, Deol works it to mid-wicket. She retains the strike picking up a single.
Length ball on middle, Deop tucks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Deop hangs back and looks to play an upper-cut but fails to connect.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Deo looks to flick but misses. Wide given.
Length delivery on middle, Mandhana whips it to mid-wicket for one.
On a length on off, tapped towards point.
Mandhana tries to break shackles! Length delivery on off, Mandhana lofts it towards long on for a couple of runs.

NOT OUT! Length delivery on the pads, nipping back in, Deol looks to clip it on the leg side but misses. She gets hit on the pads. Sciver appeals for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger. Harleen Deol has a word with Smriti Mandhana and takes a review. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows wickets missing. Deol survives. A good review from Deol.

Review time! Harleen Deol has been adjudged LBW but she has decided to take it upstairs after a brief chat with Smriti Mandhana. Will technology save her? Let's see. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows it is missing the leg stump. The on-field decision will be overturned.
Touch fuller on off, eased to mid off for a single.
On a length on middle, Deol whips it to mid-wicket. She opens her account with a single.
Straighter delivery and on middle, Mandhana pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Mandhana lets it sail through.
Length ball on middle, Mandhana works it to mid on.

Dot to finish the over. Excellent first over from Katherine Brunt. Just one run and also the big wicket of Shafali Verma. The last ball is on off, Harleen Deol pushes it to mid off to see off the first over.
Natalie Sciver to bowl from the other end.
Right on the money! Full ball on middle and swinging away. Harleen Deol blocks it with a straight bat to begin her innings.
Harleen Deol walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! BOWLED! England Women strike in the very first over. The World No.1 Women's T20I batter is out of here without troubling the scorers. The experience of Brunt gets the better of young Shafali Verma...yet again!  Good length ball swinging away yet again. Shafali Verma clears her front leg and looks to flat bat it through mid off. The ball though does not rise as much as she expected. It takes the inside edge and onto the stumps. Poor shot but brilliant from Katherine Brunt.
Swing for Brunt! Fullish ball on middle, Verma clears her front leg and looks to hit it on the on side. The ball swings away from her. Shafali adjusts herself and tucks it to the on side.
Smriti Mandhana and India Women are up and running! On the pads, Mandhana plays the natraj pull to deep square leg for a single.
Brunt starts with a very beautiful delivery! Full ball around off, forces Smriti to go for the drive. The ball though swings in and goes past the outside edge.
We are set to begin! The England Women players make their way to the middle. Followed by the India Women openers - Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma. Katherine Brunt to begin with the ball.
India Women (PLAYING XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Harleen Deol, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Arundhati Reddy, Shikha Pandey, Radha Yadav, Poonam Yadav.

England Women (PLAYING XI) - Tammy Beaumont, Danni Wyatt, Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight (C), Amy Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Mady Villiers, Sarah Glenn, Freya Davies.
TOSS - Up goes the coin. It lands in the favor of India Women. They have elected to BAT first.

Hello and welcome to the third and final T20I between England Women and India Women. The final leg of this multi-format tour and both the teams have everything to play for. Harmanpreet Kaur and Co. bounced back in the previous game and will be looking to win the T20I series and end the tour by drawing the multi-format tour. On the other hand, England Women will be eager to get back to winning ways and end this tour by sealing both the white ball series. Time for the final leg of this wonderful tour and we still await answers. Will England Women win the multi-format tour or will India Women end the tour by taking home the T20I series? Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
